Did y’all know Black Americans created Butter Pecan Ice cream because we weren’t allowed to eat Vanilla IceCream in the south. 

That’s a fact…you probably won’t find in a history book. 

Read banned books. 👌🏽Especially if you live in the south.

items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Former Celtics guard RJ Luis is granted eligibility to play for LSU this season, per On3.

Luis never played for Boston or its G League affiliate in Maine. An injury stood in the way of him suiting up for the latter.

A year later, he's in the SEC.
